title: Close — pilot agreed, verbal commit
planted: next step: signature early next week

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: So — proposal's in front of you. Two locations, ninety day pilot, and we landed at twenty six per seat with the recall tooling included.

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: Twenty six I can sell. Dr. Mehta looked at it last night and his only question was whether we're locked in if the pilot goes badly.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: You're not. If the pilot fails your numbers, you walk at ninety days and your lines port right back. That's in section four.

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: That clause is what got him to yes, honestly. Okay. The two pilot sites are the downtown location and the Elm Street one.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Busiest and smallest — smart. Cutover happens on a weekend like we said. Your phones never go dark on a patient day.

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: One more thing I noticed in the proposal. The call recordings — can we use those for training the new front desk hires? Because that alone might fix my churn problem.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Yes, and I'll set up the training library view for your office manager as part of onboarding. No extra line item.

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: Then we're done negotiating. Send the agreement over, I'll have Dr. Mehta sign early next week, and let's aim the cutover for the weekend after.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Agreement goes out this afternoon. Rahul — genuinely looking forward to this one.

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: Get my after-hours patients booking again and I'll be your reference customer. Talk next week.
